title: Alpha factory says replicated for admission checks only

hosted_verification.statement: Hosted verification was not run in this task; this file records functional unit, contract, typecheck, lint, production build, and isolated fixture E2E evidence only. Hosted deployment and live browser verification are owned by downstream task EVO-ALPHA-PAGES-HOSTED-ACCEPT-20261107.

ac1_replicated_column_title_and_caption.detail: In src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts and src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts, alphaFactory.col.replicated reads '已通過准入檢查' and 'Admission checks passed', and AlphaFactoryBoard.tsx renders alphaFactory.replicatedCaption (data-testid='alpha-factory-replicated-caption') beneath the replicated column header stating that these checks review the strategy spec, lineage, and governance records and do not rerun a backtest.

ac2_subtitle_names_three_columns_without.detail: alphaFactory.subtitle names the three columns with the updated wording in both locales ('Discovered → Scaffolded → Admission checks passed: ...' in en-US and '探索發現 → 結構建立 → 已通過准入檢查：...' in zh-TW), and the zh-TW subtitle no longer contains the English word 'Scaffolded'.

ac3_card_check_runs_failures_replays_and.detail: AlphaFactoryBoard.tsx renders experiment_run_ids count as '檢查執行次數' / 'Check runs', attempt_count as '本輪失敗次數' / 'Failures since last replay', replay_count as '重新排入次數' / 'Replays', and last_replayed_at ('最後重排時間' / 'Last replayed at') when present; null values preserve the existing '未回報' / 'Not reported' marker.

ac4_non_empty_last_error_rendered_and_nu.detail: When card.last_error is a non-empty string, AlphaFactoryBoard.tsx renders the last failure reason row (data-testid='alpha-factory-card-last-error-<id>', label '最後失敗原因' / 'Last failure reason'); when card.last_error is null or empty, nothing is added.

ac5_retired_strategy_state_badge_without.detail: When card.strategy_state === 'retired', AlphaFactoryBoard.tsx renders an outline Badge (data-testid='alpha-factory-card-retired-<id>') with '已退役' in zh-TW and 'Retired' in en-US; when strategy_state is 'approved', null, or any other value, no badge is rendered and all 4 replicated cards remain in the replicated lane. Degraded alpha_factory_strategy_state surface metadata does not flip the board out of live mode.

ac6_evolution_journal_zh_tw_history_labe.detail: In src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts, mgmt.evolution.viewHistory reads '演化歷史', mgmt.evolution.showHistory reads '返回演化歷史', and mgmt.evolution.emptyHistoryTitle reads '目前尚無已執行的演化歷史' (dropping '真實'), while src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts is unchanged. EvolutionJournalPage.test.tsx verifies both the single-row-per-decision history (page_info.total 3) and deduplicated auto_proposals (page_info.total 2571) shapes and the updated zh-TW labels.

ac7_dto_normalizer_and_mock_fixtures_ali.detail: AlphaFactoryCard in src/lib/bff-v1/dto.ts and normalizeAlphaFactoryCard / MOCK_REPLICATED / MOCK_SCAFFOLDED / MOCK_ALPHA_FACTORY_ENVELOPE in src/lib/bff-v1/alphaFactory.ts carry replay_count, last_replayed_at, revalidation_count, strategy_state, and meta.surfaces.alpha_factory_strategy_state matching the real hosted records from BFF-EVO-ALPHA-PAGE-TRUTH-20261107 so mock and live share one code path.

ac8_i18n_parity_typecheck_tests_build_an.detail: Both locales carry every new label and i18nParity.test.ts passes; typecheck:app, typecheck:agora, eslint, test:contract, all affected Vitest suites, production vite build, and Playwright e2e:fixture all exited 0. Hosted verification was not run.
